summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (writes control and returns True when is_terminal, else False); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and a Windows-only test_control_set_window_title. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Black formatting was not verified by running it; line lengths were checked by hand.
